tests.description: Reference: the start-of-sub-step saturation block of mp_wsm6_run (phys/physics_mmm/mp_wsm6.F90, ctessum-claude/MMM-physics fork 52cfbd7, instrumented) dumped in-model by the ctessum-claude/WRF fork and replayed through the real64 (kind_phys = real64) kernels/wsm6_driver at the WRF step; the block is evaluated once per sub-step from the kernel's input temperature, vapor and pressure (t, q, p), which are the inputs here (real32 values of the dump widened to real64, as the driver read them), and the expected qsat_w, rh_w, qsat_i, rh_i, xl and cpm are the replay's values (POINTWISE, step-free). Real64 replay vs real32 dump: qsat_w 1.3e-6, rh_w 1.6e-6, xl 5e-8, cpm 8e-8 relative. Residual mismatch between this component and the real64 kernel comes from the real32 WRF constants the kernel receives (cpv = 1846.4000244, rv = 461.6000061, psat = 610.78003, t0c = 273.1499939, ep2 = 0.62175041, cliq/cice exact) and its default-real literal 0.01 in ttp, which this component takes at their nominal values from lib/wrf_constants.esm; measured with zero tolerances it is <= 4.4e-7 of the column maximum in qsat_w/qsat_i (9e-9 kg/kg), 5.8e-7 in rh_w/rh_i (1.4e-6), 6e-9 in xl (0.016 J/kg, from t0c = 273.1499939), 3.4e-10 in cpm, and <= 1.1e-7 relative in the exponents xa, xb, xai, xbi. Tolerances are set 5-10x above the measured residual: relative 1e-6 spot checks, absolute Linf_error bounds at 1e-6 of each column's maximum. Regime: em_quarter_ss supercell step 250, tile row j = 23, column i = 24 (the warm_rain.esm reference column): T from 298 K at the surface to 203 K aloft, freezing level at layer 9, so both the water branch (T >= ttp: qsat_i = qsat_w) and the ice branch of the saturation formula are exercised; rh_w up to 1.55 (supersaturated updraft), qsat_w from 2e-2 down to 1.2e-5 kg/kg.
